facts.text: Sul Ross State University holds the distinction of being the 1949 birthplace of the National Intercollegiate Rodeo Association.

sources.title: College of Agriculture, Life and Physical Sciences (ALPS) - SUL ROSS
sources.quote: The College of ALPS is also the home of the award winning SRSU Rodeo team, with the distinction of being the 1949 birthplace of the National Intercollegiate Rodeo Association.
